case.summary: Last night the old herbalist was murdered at the mill. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.

evidence.text: Kanya was at the weaver's hall from 11 pm until 3 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
Only Anan, Tawan and Rin live in the west row of houses.
Chai says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
Kanya, Ek and Chai live in the south row.
Rin was at the forge from 11 pm until 3 am; the priest confirms it.
Tawan was seen at the shrine at 10 pm, laughing with friends.
Nobody can say where Ek was after 11 pm.
Ek had argued loudly with the old herbalist that afternoon.
Ek sells bread at the market on weekdays.
Rin's lantern was found near the mill the next morning; Rin says it was lent out days ago.
Investigators found red clay at the mill, and a trail leading toward the west row of houses.
Anan was at the tavern from 10 pm until 3 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
The rope of the well was replaced last spring.
The old herbalist was found dead at the mill. The healer says death happened around 1 am.
The chapel bell rang at 9 pm, as it does every night.
